load_seq2seq_speech_model: load a speech seq2seq model like whisper-tiny using AutoModelForSpeechSeq2Seq for automatic speech recognition
quantize_decoder_linear: quantize the decoder linear layers of a speech seq2seq model with 4-bit or 8-bit weight quantization
quantize_encoder_linear: quantize the encoder linear layers of a speech seq2seq model with a separate quantization config
quantize_decoder_embedding: quantize the decoder embedding layers of a speech seq2seq model with 4-bit or 8-bit weight quantization
export_asr_model: export a speech recognition model to a Seq2SeqLMExportableModule ready for ExecuTorch lowering
